description: Find commits authored by a given login in a repo. Returns SHAs (identical across GitHub and GitLab, invariant #5) with a REST path to fetch each, so you can cross-reference against either provider.

author.description: The author's login, matched without regard to case, e.g. 'athena'.

provider.description: The git host whose REST path each returned commit carries, 'github', 'gitlab', 'bitbucket' or 'ado', defaulting to 'github'; commits are read from GitHub either way, because the SHAs are identical on every host.

repo.description: The repository name without the organisation, e.g. 'parthenon', the flagship repo, which is used when omitted.

name: search_commits_by_author
title: Search commits by author
